title: [codereview] dummy now_ms=0 breaks RPL timers
description: forward_mesh_to_upstream calls process_rpl(..., 0). RPL DODAG, trickle timer, DAO lifetime calculations require accurate monotonic time. Fix to pass real time from Instant or SystemTime. P1 correctness. discovered-from:project-LICHEN-r83o
close_reason: Verified fixed in live code: lichend.rs:613-617 computes monotonic now_ms via START_TIME OnceLock + Instant::elapsed() and passes it to gw.process_rpl (no process_rpl(...,0) on production paths; tests pass 0 deliberately for deterministic vectors). gateway.rs:177-189 threads now_ms into maintain()/handle_frame_rpl/complete_dao_from_frame so DODAG, trickle, and DAO lifetime use real time. cargo check -p lichen-gateway clean.
